prompt: Comprehensive Taxonomy of Architectural and Interior Design Movements, Historical Typologies, Material Tectonics, and Empirical Portfolio Design Systems for AI Design Agents

name: portfolio-monograph
description: Master spatial portfolio design, curation, and architectural critique system created by Sara Bensalem. Provides Swiss typography rules, 10 layout archetypes, the 5-act spatial case study narrative, and a 100-point audit rubric to eliminate render traps and build high-converting architecture, interior architecture, and urban design portfolios.
author: Sara Bensalem <sara@sarabensalem.com>

name: constructive-detail
scale_continuum: 1:20 Tectonic Wall Sections & Hygrothermal Glaser Calculations

name: spatial-anatomy

author: Sara Bensalem Studio

cli_commands.description: Validates French PMR & US ADA wheelchair accessibility, 900mm doors, and emergency egress

author: Sara Bensalem Studio

mcp_tools.name: calculate_bioclimatic_flows

cli_commands.description: Astronomical solar geometry, overhang sizing, and buoyancy stack ventilation across 5 climate presets

name: interior-joinery
scale_continuum: 1:5 Custom Millwork, Shadow Reveals & Hardware Clearance

description: Socratic architectural design review jury and portfolio cross-examiner. Interactively grills architects and designers on buildability, 1:20 constructive detailing, thermal breaks, spatial circulation, PMR/ADA compliance, and recruiter trust ergonomics before issuing high-stakes hiring and competition verdicts.
author: Sara Bensalem Studio
